title: Overthinking: Amplifying Reasoning Weights to Extract Learned Secrets
abstract: arXiv:2607.08173v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Black box auditing of language models is an essential pre-deployment tool, but it may miss subtle forms of misalignment and hidden information. To better elicit hidden information during an auditing process, we introduce \emph{overthinking}: the process of using reasoning task vectors to amplify the propensity to think out loud of reasoning models. translated_title: 过度思考：通过放大推理权重来提取学习到的秘密
translated_abstract: 语言模型的黑盒审计是部署前的重要工具，但它可能会遗漏微妙的不对齐形式和隐藏信息。为了在审计过程中更好地引出隐藏信息，我们提出了“过度思考”：即利用推理任务向量来放大推理模型“大声思考”倾向的过程。给定非推理指令模型 M 的参数和推理蒸馏模型 R 的参数，我们将“过度思考模型”定义为 θ_O_α = θ_M + α(θ_R - θ_M)，其中 α > 1 会将推理放大到超出纯推理模型 R 的程度。此外，我们引入了新的逐层衰减策略，可以选择性地放大推理而不损失模型输出的质量和连贯性。我们证明了过度思考模型更可能揭示隐藏的信息。
tldr: 本文提出“过度思考”技术，通过以 α > 1 的权重插值放大推理蒸馏模型的推理参数，并结合新的逐层衰减策略，在保持输出质量的同时增强模型“大声思考”的倾向，从而在黑盒审计中更有效地提取模型隐藏的秘密信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "overthinking," a technique that amplifies reasoning weights in reasoning-distilled models via weight interpolation with α > 1, combined with novel layer-wise attenuation strategies, to enhance models' propensity to think out loud without sacrificing output quality, thereby more effectively extracting hidden secrets during black-box auditing.
